g.title: SHIELD_ZLIM
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — Z+ end-stop header (= R4 D11, hardware PWM)

The 2-pin 'Z+' pair in the END STOPS column. Only the signal pin is used (5 V PWM, 50 Hz, 500–2500 µs); the servo's ground goes to the XL4015 instead. D11 is free because no limit switches are fitted.

g.title: W_SIG
g.text: tilt's orange lead (or a servo extension) to the Z+ pin

g.title: TILT
g.text: Cut the 3-pin plug off or use a servo extension: orange to the shield's Z+ pin, red/brown soldered to the XL4015 OUT pads. Limits 65–150° in the firmware ('t 90').

g.title: SHIELD_XLIM
g.text: CNC Shield v3 — X+ end-stop header (= R4 D9, hardware PWM)
The 2-pin 'X+' pair in the END STOPS column. Signal only; the servo's ground goes to the XL4015. D9 is free because no limit switches are fitted.

g.title: W_PSIG
g.text: pan's orange lead to the X+ pin

g.title: PAN
g.text: Orange to the shield's X+ pin, red/brown soldered to the XL4015 OUT pads beside the tilt servo's. Firmware 'p DEG' (angle) or 'n DIR MS' (timed nudge for a continuous-rotation unit).

g.title: XL4015
g.text: HiLetgo XL4015 5 A buck — trim OUT to 5.0 V

HiLetgo board: four big solder pads, IN+/IN− at the coil end, OUT+/OUT− at the other — tin them and solder the 22 AWG wires (no screw terminals). Set 5.00 V on the meter with nothing on OUT (pot turns counter-clockwise to lower). 4 A continuous, 5 A peak. Three wires per OUT pad: pan, tilt, fan. 5.0 V (not 6) so the fan can share this rail; the MG996R runs 4.8–7.2 V.

g.title: W_SERVO
g.text: tilt red/brown to the XL4015 OUT+ / OUT− pads; 2 A at stall

g.title: W_PAN
g.text: pan red/brown to the same pads

g.title: W_FAN
g.text: fan on the same two pads

g.title: FAN
g.text: 40 mm 5 V fan on the driver heatsinks
5 V 0.15 A (listing). Leads soldered to the XL4015 OUT pads beside the servo's.
